transcript.text: What's a money mistake you see people
make before they realize it's a problem?
>> Lifestyle. I know a lot of guys
>> [music]
>> who spend 100% of their check into their
40s because they want to live a certain
way or like look a certain way.
>> [music]
>> Right or wrong, the amount of risk you
can take in your business is typically
inversely proportional to the amount of
risk you take in your lifestyle. I would
say for me, really big opportunities
come once every two-ish years. All the
times I don't have the big opportunity,
I just save with the faith that I will
see it when it comes and that just means
that when it does come I'll be able to
back the truck up because I'll have
stuff I'll have a truck
and I can back it up rather than being
like, "Oh wow, there's a bunch of gold
and all I have is what I can carry with
my two hands."
